name: SV3 Week 4 R4 — SV2 inventory fix and offline handoff
body:
Week 4 R4: fix OS-dependent SV2 inventory list ordering, preserving cache protections and immutable v1/R3.

Fix/export commit: `89109fd352d84a5fe0815d7e045e52538de7bad8`.
Delivery/source commit: `3055bc403ea752f20699c454d67fdfafaada08b2`.
PR #17 was squash-merged before this fix and remains the R3 handoff history. The follow-up PR uses sv3/week4-r4-inventory-fix, with an explicitly authorized history-only merge commit whose tree is identical to the delivery commit. Main does not contain the fix until that PR is reviewed and merged. No automatic PR merge, force push, flash, retraining or later-week implementation.

18 official release commands and 19 final bundle-checkout commands exited 0 on Windows Python 3.11.9 with project-pinned dependencies, without source overlays. Cache/inventory suite: 15 PASS and 1 real-symlink SKIP (Windows privilege); simulated symlink guard PASS. Full verifier passes 200 ONNX comparisons for real v1 and simulated POSIX/reversed inventory ordering. Missing/extra/duplicate entries and wrong hash/size/shape/dtype/anchor remain rejected.

WSL Ubuntu 24.04 reproduced real POSIX Path ordering, but has Python 3.12.3 and no pinned tensor dependencies: FULL LINUX VERIFIER PENDING. SV1/SV2 receiver acknowledgement PENDING. Local checks are not device acceptance.

R4 artifact ZIP: `mitdb-sv1-week4-fp32-20261001-r4.zip`, SHA-256 `0b29c1f0bd1327efdf5cad17d0dcfd40fb76cb9d8f7dce3ee8dc5ab4c25dfd8e`, 5659076 bytes.
Week 4 manifest anchor: `3ca39030081c6b53a5191f927ead6fdc84cdeba1c69766bbdbc9f1cb9ca3d49a`.
Week 3 v1 manifest anchor unchanged: `a6d16809036c035936825b0e0cdc178e0bdf9f53ca81a132ece0522911d3d2a6`.
Original v1 ZIP unchanged: `b7f5b8d0bcd5ec27755f3e44541c0d24a6d23bdd27e199660a7b653bc30a71c7`.

389 historical local files preserved. All 26 scientific R3/R4 files and host-C report are byte-identical. Only manifest source_git_commit and the two changed source_files hashes differ. R3 is preserved and its old source-hash gate correctly rejects the new source.

Use the self-contained bundle plus authenticated R4 artifact ZIP for Week 4; use the FIXED SOURCE CHECKOUT verifier with SV2's ORIGINAL v1 package. Never replace scripts inside v1. Follow sv3_sv1_week4_handoff_r4.md for commands and return evidence. SHA256SUMS.txt and source_transfer_receipt.json identify exact assets/commits; r4-validation-logs.zip contains export and final-checkout logs with exit status and SHA bindings.

The bundled documents were prepared under the initial instruction not to open a new PR. The later authorization permits the follow-up PR above; the assets and their pinned source/export commits remain unchanged. Release tag date 20261003 is intentionally retained when resuming on 2026-10-04.
